title: Portfolio Discount Terms — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
A landlord's Rental Property Service Contracts contracts combine for a portfolio discount on premium.

**Clause 1 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "The number of contracts counted is the landlord's portfolio count, a snapshot taken on the first day of the term being priced, counting only contracts held under the same customer profile (contracts of a spouse, partner or separate company profile are never combined)." The portfolio count is the number of the landlord's rental property service contracts, this one included, whose status on that day is waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment; for a new enrollment the day is its start date. This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a re-rating correction, for an installment that fell due and was never billed, and for an upgrade difference charge, the term's portfolio discount rate is the rate recorded on the installment for the term's first billing period instead of counting the portfolio again, and only for those; every other premium is still counted as this clause states.

**Clause 2 — the bands.** When the count is at or above the tier's high-band minimum the discount is the high-band rate; otherwise, when it is at or above the mid-band minimum, it is the mid-band rate; otherwise it is 0.00. The bands do not stack: exactly one rate applies. On every tier the mid band starts at 3 contracts with a rate of 0.05 and the high band at 10 contracts with a rate of 0.10.

**Clause 3 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "The rate is fixed for the whole term: enrolling, cancelling, expiring or transferring other properties during the term never changes the installments already set, and the rate is taken again at each renewal and late renewal." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a late renewal, the portfolio discount rate recorded on the expired term's annual premium charge is carried into the new term instead of counting the portfolio again, and only for such a late renewal; every other renewal remains as this clause states.

**Clause 4 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "The rate applies to monthly installment, annual premium and upgrade proration charges and never to returned payment, returned-payment fee or transfer fee charges." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a returned-payment fee a fixed-dollar portfolio courtesy set by the contract's recorded portfolio discount rate is granted, and only for such a fee; the portfolio discount rate itself is still never applied as a percentage to a returned payment, a returned-payment fee or a transfer fee.

**Clause 5 — transfers.** A transferred contract keeps its rate until the purchaser's first renewal, when the purchaser's own portfolio is counted.

## Clause 2 by count (all tiers)

| Contracts counted | Portfolio discount rate |
|---|---|
| 1 or 2 | 0.00 |
| 3 to 9 | 0.05 (mid band) |
| 10 or more | 0.10 (high band) |

*Hypothetical:* a landlord with 9 contracts in force on the first day of the term being priced takes 0.05; with 10, 0.10 alone, never 0.05 and 0.10 together.

The rate is fixed for the whole term: enrolling, cancelling, expiring or transferring other properties during the term never changes the installments already set, and the rate is taken again at each renewal and late renewal.
